fullPassage: "Where could it be?" Sophie asked herself. It had been more than ten years since she had last visited the area where she had grown up. The village had changed a lot over time. Uncertain, she awkwardly looked around at her surroundings. She walked the narrow streets of the village, unsure about which way to go. Suddenly, Sophie saw a familiar sight. "Yes, this must be it," she thought. In front of her was a wall with flowers painted on it. Although the colors were now faded, the familiar shapes on the wall were the same ones she had painted with her father as a child. Sophie nodded, smiled brightly, and walked toward the gate. At last, she had finally found the house she had grown up in.

det.korean: surround(동사: 둘러싸다) → surroundings(명사: 주변 환경): her 뒤에 명사 필요, 항상 복수형(-s)
det.analysis: surround(동사) → surrounding(형용사: 주변의) → surroundings(명사: 주변 환경): 소유격 her 뒤에는 명사가 와야 함
det.tip: surroundings(주변 환경)는 항상 복수형(-s)으로 사용한다

questions.passage: "Where could it be?" Sophie asked herself. It had been more than ten years since she had last visited the area where she had grown up. The village had changed a lot over time. Uncertain, she awkwardly looked around at her surroundings. She walked the narrow streets of the village, unsure about which way to go. Suddenly, Sophie saw a familiar sight. "Yes, this must be it," she thought. In front of her was a wall with flowers painted on it. Although the colors were now faded, __________ were the same ones she had painted with her father as a child. Sophie nodded, smiled brightly, and walked toward the gate. At last, she had finally found the house she had grown up in.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: the bright flowers on the gate
the familiar shapes on the wall
the narrow streets of the village

det.korean: 비록 색은 바랬지만, 벽의 익숙한 모양들(the familiar shapes on the wall)은 아버지와 그렸던 것과 같았다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② the familiar shapes on the wall: 원문 일치 — Although 양보절 뒤 주절의 주어
❌ ① the bright flowers on the gate: 원문과 다름 (wall, faded)
❌ ③ the narrow streets: 거리는 벽화와 무관
❌ ④ the surroundings: 주변 환경은 벽화와 무관
det.tip: Although(비록~이지만) 양보 구문: 색은 바랬지만(양보) + 모양은 같았다(주절)

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: a wall with flowers painted on it
a gate with her name written on it
a street with familiar houses along it
a garden with roses growing in it

det.korean: 그녀 앞에 꽃이 그려진 벽(a wall with flowers painted on it)이 있었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① a wall with flowers painted on it: 원문 일치
❌ ② a gate with her name: 원문에 없는 내용
❌ ③ a street with houses: 원문에 없는 내용
❌ ④ a garden with roses: 원문에 없는 내용
det.tip: In front of her was ~: 도치 구문 (장소 부사구 + 동사 + 주어)
